label: endless
limitations: Deterministic policy outcomes are not human completion rates.

This continues the independent experiment initiated after the October 23 adoption; imported original shards are actual earlier outcomes, not new observations or rerun successes. No parameters changed during the pause or continuation.
An error, invalid value, budget exhaustion, cancellation or missing identity is rejected; natural death is a resolved outcome.
TTK is birth-to-death active player-clock time, including approach. Living enemies at player death are censored; rank buckets are not exact medians.

Star births include every role, fixed 2/3-star mini-bosses, 1-star main bosses, escorts and summons. Fusion promotions are not additional births. Budget affordability and fixed escorts change the mixture; these counts are not an unbiased estimator of ordinary-wave starWeights. Native weights and budget conservation rely on direct-draw and real-World budget regression tests.
Unentered endless depths are not passing evidence. The post-target zero-time stage is only a reward-boundary sentinel.
Baseline lacks new lifecycle/TTK/cast observations; unavailable telemetry is never invented as zero.
